native: native evidence stays NOT_RUN and is a separate claim; a planning PASS must never read as native proof
rule: lanes/DG-OWN-C3.md general successor rule: a frozen original package that cannot express behavior today's owner text already requires gets an explicitly versioned successor; the predecessor stays byte-exact and readable as history

defect.requirement: SP-305 requires the complete AssignmentAudit (every source selector, the complete recursive EventRecord encoding tree, the complete numeric path-domain inventory of Plans/goal_cancel_contracts/numeric-paths.json, four codec resources, the reservation and the original issuer) in one immutable value; the DL-270 amendment gives each execution-binding family a 16 KiB maximum value size (SP-340) and selects no reference route for this family
defect.measured_counterexample: scripts/pm_goal_dg_ca_oracles.py C4A/positive/predecessor_inline_audit_over_cap records the measured complete StorageAssignmentAudit MessagePack size of a genuine assignment; the numeric path-domain member alone exceeds 12 KiB

successor.key_recipe: SP-305 O = k(storage_instance_id):k(project_id):k(thread_id):k(goal_id):k(operation_id) lowercase UTF-8 hex; N canonical decimal

pack.content: the complete unchanged StorageAssignmentAudit wrapper (predecessor root) in Storage canonical MessagePack
pack.durability: SP-337: the pack is durable before the reference record is written; the reference is never acknowledged first
pack.verification: every reader resolves the pack, verifies BLAKE3, byte size and media type, verifies audit_value_sha256 over the exact bytes, decodes and validates the whole predecessor root, and compares scope, operation, attempt, commitment and issuer with the reference
pack.lifetime: existing SP-337 source-coupled payload lifetime under the referencing record's existing RP-AUTHORITY-INDEFINITE@1.0.0; no new retention, TTL, hold or deletion choice

successor.assignment_selection: AssignmentAdmission.assignment and DomainCommitmentInput.assignment are the PhysicalSelection of the complete successor reference wrapper; its SHA-256 commits to the pack through audit_value_sha256 and the BLAKE3 reference
unchanged: every predecessor bank, URI, hash and stored byte

integration: storage_value_registry rows for the successor family are a merge item; no registry row is added on this branch
